name: knit-with-parameters
description: Launches an interactive graphical workspace that prompts you to customize input values defined in the YAML header prior to rendering a parameterized R Markdown or Quarto report.

knitWithParameters.rscriptPath.description: Optional Rscript executable override. Empty (or Rscript) automatically searches PATH and standard R installations on the extension host. Uses a separate R process, not the active console.

knitWithParameters.quartoPath.description: Optional Quarto executable override. Empty (or quarto) automatically searches PATH, the IDE's bundled Quarto, and standard installation locations on the extension host.

knitWithParameters.pythonPath.description: Optional Python executable override. Empty automatically searches Python 3 then Python on PATH and standard installation locations on the extension host. Uses a separate Python process, not the active console. Arbitrary !python expressions are evaluated only after consent.
